name: Today
q: Those who say tomorrow rarely succeed
Don't put off today's work till tomorrow
The first day of the rest of your life
Tomorrow the sun will rise anyway
The day's plan is made at dawn
Yesterday's gone, tomorrow's not here, only today is
Not a day without a line
More things scare us than harm us
The sun is new every day
A day dawns only once; strive in time
Do what lies clearly at hand
Order each day as if it were a complete life
Write it on your heart that every day is the best day in the year
What is not started today is never finished tomorrow
Hold infinity in the palm of your hand, and eternity in an hour
